subject: FINAL HANDOFF ticket06: Fold7 hinge telemetry is instrumentation-ready; micro-gesture thresholds remain physical-test gated
body: Two-cycle ticket06 research is complete on revalidated main 7127c287a17fd97050c98fbeb05a38f7318f2f64. Current source already provides observation-only public hinge metadata/timestamps, shared Transition Lab timing, source-aware authoritative geometry, and stale/session/sequence fencing. Existing Fold7 evidence proves Samsung precise telemetry can run around 111–112 accepted samples/s when its answering route is alive but has substantial topology blackout/timeout windows; Android TYPE_HINGE_ANGLE is on-change, so an 8 ms registration request is not proof of fixed 125 Hz delivery. No reliable micro-gesture degree threshold can be claimed from current evidence. The recommended next step is the published physical Fold7 matrix: source inventory; supported/handheld static holds; ordinary sweeps/reversals and >=20 30–70° oscillations; calibrated 0.5/1/2/3/5° experimental micro-motion labels with external ground truth and randomized controls; handling-confound false-positive measurement; and failover falsification. Any future recognizer is a feature-flagged consumer of physically validated fine measured geometry only, cancels on stale/source/session/generation/overflow/failover boundaries, and never consumes predicted/virtual hinge state. Production source changed: none. Physical Fold7 run: not available in this session; all thresholds stay PHYSICAL_TEST_REQUIRED.
